# Finite full-history diagnostic

This diagnostic is not a benchmark or a production renderer change. The owning
[task continuation](../../plans/phase-fframes-eight-styles-2026-10-25.md#authorized-full-history-recovery-diagnosis---2026-10-26)
authorizes one disposable exact-SHA CI series, not retries or style expansion.

The original frozen `vpnrouter-film` executable renders every anime frame from
zero with its one persistent render worker, converter/cache/pool and 45 original
24-frame encoder lifetimes. It retains the original segments and silent concat.
Fresh matched plain/instrumented x264 builds are not historical distro replay.
Both variants retain the existing public observer; P/A is not fully unobserved.

The schedule is fixed: three synthetic plain/off/on processes, two consecutive
24-frame lifetimes each, then full anime P/plain, A/on, B/on. B requires synthetic
transparency, P/A transparency and historical observed-input/settings binding.
The total cap is six processes, 3384 frames, 141 completed lifetimes. Any missing
operand, unsupported source/state, same-file redecode mismatch or failed gate
stops. Equal A/B output ends at `NO_REPRODUCTION_FULL_HISTORY` without accepting
a baseline. No further execution is authorized by that result.

The internal hook records exact visible I420 entry and post-mod16 NV12 coded
rectangles, both valid float offset arrays after AQ and before slices, and raw
four-byte fractional qpm in its private source scope after the existing emms.
The full-history parser joins actual consumed PTS across delayed output/flush;
open/close generations, not native pointer addresses, identify lifetimes. Raw
pictures and typed arrays are streamed into exclusive per-operand evidence.
No arbitrary row tails, allocation slack, whole structs or optional pointees
are read. qpm stability is conditional on observed source-supported no-VBV and
thread/configuration assertions, not inferred from equal integer slice QP.

The packet binder reads saved MP4 bytes, sample tables, ffprobe reports and two
framehash decodes per segment and concat. It binds complete native SPS/PPS/SEI
and native output tuples across AVCC/Annex-B framing using exact rational PTS.
All 45 segments have their own header coverage; concat avcC alone cannot supply
that evidence. The standalone modules never invoke a media executable.

Only CI runs native compilation, rendering or decoding. Source/data contracts
run with `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1`; they do not establish native transparency.
The workflow always attempts to upload original/partial/failing evidence and
build operands. A runner loss or hard timeout can still prevent that upload.
The series emits no accepted quality/measurement receipt, timing improvement,
confirmed cause, baseline, best or confirmation. Preserve both evaluator locks,
original sources/media/licenses, all eight delivered previews and music work.
